body_markdown:
You can now upload PowerPoint files (.pptx) and advanced Word documents (.docx) as sources. Frigade Assistant reads the text and speaker notes on each slide and uses them in answers the same way it would interpret a text file or markdown.


Training decks and onboarding presentations often exist only as slides. Now the assistant can answer from them without anyone having to convert them to a document first.


Open an uploaded deck on the


[Sources page](https://app.frigade.ai/sources) to page through its slides or read the text Frigade pulled from it.
